title: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors – Admin 0 countries (v5.1.2): Canada and the US
license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com. The outlines of Canada and the US, simplified, are used only to check that a trip stays in the country it starts in.
notes: Owner decisions B74 (2026-11-17) and B78 (2026-11-18): the trip function refuses a start outside Canada and the US, or a destination outside the start's country, before calling openrouteservice. Downloaded by hand with npm run fetch:outlines, which writes data/imported/naturalearth/{ca,us}.json (with the download's checksum; the US outline includes Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Guam, the Northern Marianas and American Samoa); only the function reads them, browsers never download them.
